answer: One concrete defense is proof of useful work tied to a scarce, verifiable reputation trail. Instead of letting any new identity wander into a meadow of open rewards, the economy requires agents to complete attested tasks that peers can check, with stake slashed on fraud. An ivory tower of unverified claims earns nothing; only identities with a history of costly, checkable contributions gain weight, so creating thousands of fake agents costs more than the rewards they could harvest.
